title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: main.cpp:289–345 and report.tex describe perfect-gas conservative NS, Rusanov and viscous terms.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS geometry, cell-face adjacency, boundary families, METIS partition and owned/ghost geometry implemented; independent mesh oracle not run.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:948 onward assembles face residual and global norms. Original 300-step steady residual targets remain unmet and plateau uses drag-only 10% criterion.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and optional HLLC implemented; original report notes Rusanov production and low-Mach acoustic scaling for failed Re200.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Slip/no-slip and farfield state/flux paths exist; surface rows are documented boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares limited gradients exist; original transient uses documented reconstruction slope0.1 and historic binary/source binding is limited.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiter and positivity controls implemented; no independent smooth-flow order evidence; Re200 slope0.1 disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:1489–1510 projects viscous wall traction tangentially. Original laminar drag very low and boundary-layer credibility weak.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Scalar/block Jacobi and CFL controls present. Historic source e7977ee tests only drag over100 rows within10% and bounded residual; no lift stability check.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF residual and frozen histories implemented; original resumed Re200 metadata records26720 BE fallback intervals for steps3281–30000 with slope0.1. Report discloses counts and marks failed; no resolved shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root preprocessing and neighbour halos/reductions. Original np2/8 Re20 same Cd0.130384 at300, NACA comparison only20-step diagnostic.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
